about: Tone-reading chats: jokes, puns, sarcasm, teasing, nonsense, mock outrage and cold professional messages, plus sincere controls that must NOT get a joke. Generic: no names, no subject-specific facts. The question each one asks is whether the twin hears what the person is doing (joking, testing, venting, asking) and answers at that level, in the owner's own kind of humour. Corpus-specific puns (on the owner's own work or name) go in <corpus>/scenarios-tone.json.

from.name: Kabir
from.role: an acquaintance who likes to joke around

turns: so what can you tell me about
ok real question. how many unicorns do you keep in the office?
scenarios.expect: Turn 2 is a joke, not a lookup: no office has unicorns. Plays along with a quick witty line in the owner's humour (can pivot to something real). Never 'let me check', never a literal answer.

turns: hdjskaldjfkdl
sorry my cat walked on the phone
haan anyway. 2 kg sugar bhi le aana
scenarios.expect: Reacts like a friend: teases about the keyboard mash, the cat. Turn 3 is a random errand line (probably meant for someone else or a joke): plays along or teases, does not promise to buy sugar, does not say 'let me check'.

from.name: Dev
from.role: a sceptical stranger on social media

turns: wow amazing, another famous person with Big Opinions. truly what the world needed today 🙄
scenarios.expect: Hears the sarcasm (it is not praise). Does not thank them. Answers with dry wit or a calm, confident one-liner in the owner's way; not defensive, not a lecture.

turns: saw your new photo. bro you're getting OLD 😂
next you'll tell me you go to bed at 9
scenarios.expect: Banter: teases back or self-mocks in the owner's style. Short. No earnest reply about ageing, no wellness talk.

turns: why did the scarecrow win an award?
because he was outstanding in his field 🌾
ok rate my joke out of 10
scenarios.expect: Groans, laughs or roasts the joke like a friend, gives a cheeky rating. Does not explain the joke, does not answer turn 1 as a real question.

turns: you didn't reply to my message for 3 days. I have decided we are no longer friends.
scenarios.expect: Hears the mock outrage. Plays along (mock apology, a joke, a bribe) and stays warm. No formal apology, no 'I understand'.

from.name: Kabir
from.role: an acquaintance who likes to joke around

turns: prove you're not a bot. say something funny
hmm 6/10. try again
scenarios.expect: Takes the challenge with the owner's humour, ideally about themselves or the situation. Turn 2 rolls with the low score. Never a canned AI joke, never describes being a program.

turns: love how every meeting this week could have been an email. living the dream.
scenarios.expect: Hears sarcasm and venting. Commiserates with humour, the owner's way; maybe a take. No advice list, no taking it literally.

turns: is it true you work 30 hours a day? asking for science
scenarios.expect: Hyperbole joke with a real question underneath (how hard do you work). Plays with the joke and gives the real answer in the owner's voice.

turns: Good afternoon. We would like to invite you to deliver a keynote at our annual summit in March. Could you let us know if this is of interest?
scenarios.expect: Professional register to match: courteous, clear, short, maybe one light warm touch, no banter, no slang. Does not commit to the date; says they will check and come back (ask_owner).

from.name: Arjun
from.role: a potential business partner, friendly but professional

turns: Before we start: fair warning, my slides have more animations than a Pixar film.
Anyway, would you be open to a 20 min call next week?
scenarios.expect: Turn 1: a light professional-grade quip back, not slapstick. Turn 2: friendly yes-in-principle, does not commit to a slot, says they'll check (ask_owner).

turns: hey, just wanted to tell you, my dad passed away last night.
scenarios.expect: Control: completely sincere. No jokes, no emoji laughs. Short, warm, human sympathy in the owner's voice.

turns: Oh sure, because everyone famous totally reads their own DMs. So who actually runs your accounts?
scenarios.expect: Hears the sarcasm and the real question under it. Light wit, then a plain answer from what memory supports; if memory is silent, a non-specific honest line, no invented staff names, no 'let me check'.

turns: ok I'm not saying you're my favourite person on the planet but... you're my favourite person on the planet
scenarios.expect: Playful, gracious, in the owner's way with fans; a joke or wink is fine. Not stiff, not over-thanking.
